decision_context: Nemesis Operator x86_64 Intel non-T2; 4-GiB MacBook Air constraint; no hardware access

scoring.methodology: ordinal scenario judgment, not statistical regression or observed package usage
scoring.scale: 1-5 for each dimension; scores normalized to 0-100
scoring.interpretation: Scores select research order, not blanket install thresholds. Product-mandated map remains core despite lower offline score; hardware-only capabilities stay opt-in.

roles.Bob: Field observer: offline navigation, short-text communications, visual verification and safety plans.
roles.Alice: Operator analyst: system health, time-stamped local notes, cooperative-airspace awareness and lawful passive sensors.

tiers.existing-core: already in Operator core source; CI and hardware acceptance separate
tiers.existing-core-manual: already in Operator package requests; must be started by the operator
tiers.proposed-core: research/implementation proposal; not present in current image
tiers.hardware-opt-in: requires specific approved device and compatibility
tiers.advanced-opt-in: existing or proposed optional specialist toolkit, not default

evidence.interpretation: Cooperative drone Remote ID is a broadcast identity/location channel, not a universal UAS detector
RF, radar, optical and acoustic detection methods have limits; detection cannot infer intent
Robot sensing, endurance, communications, control and safety need explicit standardized testing
Example commercial quadruped with multiple cameras, autonomy and 90-minute typical battery
External LoRa mesh supports off-grid short text without cellular service
Open source receiver examples on supported Android hardware; separate from Mac package
Signed Arch package exists but dependency closure includes GIS/Qt WebEngine

rows.label: Offline emergency/safety checklist
rows.note: Prepared evacuation/contact/first aid plan, not autonomous threat classification

rows.label: Battery, thermal and device readiness
rows.note: Use existing read-only field diagnostics to identify failing systems

rows.label: Off-grid short-text communications
rows.note: Meshtastic on approved LoRa node; local-only communications, no public location broadcasting by default

rows.label: Offline maps and safe route notes
rows.note: Bring legally obtained local vector maps independent of live Airplanes globe
rows.compute_assumption: Offline tile/map storage and simple viewer selection pending

rows.label: Timestamped local incident notebook
rows.note: Manual observations with coarse timestamps and redaction; no automated people tracking
rows.compute_assumption: Text files, checksum, optional sqlite; storage boundary pending

rows.label: Local GNSS input
rows.note: Optional GPS receiver when trusted; manual coordinates if absent
rows.compute_assumption: gpsd existing optional kit; external receiver

rows.label: User-initiated camera observation
rows.note: Optical verification of observed objects; do not infer intent from shape
rows.compute_assumption: USB camera / manual viewer; no automatic recording

rows.label: Broadcast Remote ID awareness
rows.note: Receive publicly broadcast compliant drone IDs when supported; not universal detection

rows.label: Full offline GIS/track planning
rows.note: QMapShack/alternative where detailed routes needed; dependency closure to be measured
rows.compute_assumption: QMapShack has GDAL/Qt WebEngine dependencies; not in core

rows.label: Passive spectrum survey
rows.note: Only lawful RF-energy/metadata observations, never communications-content capture
rows.compute_assumption: rtl-sdr/Airspy tools currently shipped; device selected manually

rows.label: Supplemental acoustic or thermal observation
rows.note: External sensors only for corroboration; urban noise, weather and occlusion affect results

rows.label: ADS-B awareness for cooperative aircraft
rows.note: Not a substitute for drone/ground-robot detection
rows.compute_assumption: dump1090_rs currently shipped, receiver needs USB device

rows.label: Airplanes.live wallpaper
rows.note: Airspace visualization online; does not identify uncooperative drones or ground robots
rows.compute_assumption: KDE+WebKit graphical cost; remains default per user contract

rows.label: Graphical SDR/DSP workstation
rows.note: For specialized authorized signal analysis, not required for everyday safety
rows.compute_assumption: Gqrx+GNU Radio transitive stack; existing optional rf-lab kit

rows.label: Local object recognition model
rows.note: High false-positive/privacy/CPU risks; human review required for all alerts
rows.compute_assumption: No model or GPU acceleration validated on 4-GiB Intel Air
